dogecoin.text: All those paperhands selling #SAFEMOON cannot see the big picture. Just because the news isn't going to 100x your money overnight doesn't mean it won't happen. This is bigger than @elonmusk accepting #dogecoin for Tesla. This is a bridge between fiat and crypto.

To my #Dogecoinarmy I think you'll find many that are invested in #SAFEMOON are also invested in #dogecoin, there is no us vs them. Many want to see both grow. I'd love to see either established permanently in top 5 as they're both community driven
